summary: Phlebotomist with roughly 15 years of experience in clinical laboratory specimen collection across outpatient, mobile, nursing home and donor collection settings. Performs aseptic venipuncture and capillary collection for patients from infants to geriatric, along with point-of-care microbiology screening and specimen receiving, storage and inventory. Experienced in lab equipment maintenance, result review and escalation of abnormal findings, and precepts new technicians. Works to CLIA, OSHA and HIPAA requirements and has prior administrative and healthcare billing-support background.

credentials.name: Certified MCS+ Automated Blood Collection Technician
